advancements.rpg_series.spell_cast_arche: Use a skill from the Archery Manual
advancements.rpg_series.trade_with_arche: Purchase an item from an Archery Artisan Villager
effect.archers.hunters_mark.description: Increases damage taken from all sources
item.archers.auto_fire_hook.description_: Can be applied to ranged weapons, on an Anvil.
item.archers.quiver.hint: Provides arrows for archery, when equipped.
item.archers.spell_book/archer.spell_bin:
Spell Book of Archers, using ranged weapons and archery skills to defeat enemies from afar
- Strengths: Dealing high damage at range and maintaining mobility
- Weaknesses: Heavily armored enemies
- Equipment: Moderately armored
spell.archers.barrage.description: Fires multiple arrows in quick succession.
spell.archers.barrage.name: Barrage
spell.archers.entangling_roots.descripti: Conjures roots to sprout from the ground in the nearby area, slowing down enemies for {cloud_duration} seconds.
spell.archers.entangling_roots.name: Entangling Roots
spell.archers.magic_arrow.description: Shoots a magical arrow piercing thru all enemies in its path, dealing {damage} damage to each target. The longer the cast is held, the harder it hits and the further the arrow flies.
spell.archers.magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
spell.archers.power_shot.description: Your next {effect_amplifier_cap} arrows inflict the target with Hunter's Mark for {effect_duration} seconds, increasing its damage taken by {effect|archers:hunters_mark}, stacking up to {effect_amplifier_cap} times.
spell.archers.power_shot.name: Power Shot
spell.archers.rain_of_arrows.description: Rains arrows over the targeted area for 5 seconds, each dealing {damage} damage to enemies within {impact_range} blocks.
spell.archers.rain_of_arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
spell.archers.spirit_wolf.description: Summons a pack of {summon_count} Spirit Wolves to fight by your side for {summon_duration} sec, empowered by your Ranged Damage.
spell.archers.spirit_wolf.name: Spirit Wolf Pack
